patterns: Winning replies on lab-ops posts (Tibo reset/ships) land in the first 30-90 seconds; image-only memes routinely outrank text.
Weekend-relief jokes dominate delay/reset threads (enjoy the weekend / thought I was about to touch grass / pointless projects).
Quota-and-reset bargaining is a standing reply genre on OpenAI community posts (preserve weekly reset date; slow mode for 0.75 quota; banked reset).
Contrarian one-liners win Elon/Carmack threads (manpower > tech, Viet Cong, Houthis/Taliban got lucky) rather than agreement.
Verbatim-quote-of-the-punchline appears on Carmack (Musashi/assault rifles) and is a mid-like format, not the top slot.
Genuine expertise is rarer in the like ranking: Carmack draws aphorism + historical riff + a long local-maxima LLM-review take; simonw draws sandbox/security questions at very low like counts.
Complaint/feature-request replies can still rank hours later on docs posts (AGI requires a .md at +5h; every model release breaks AGENTS.md).
Official self-thread dumps (ChatGPT Sites) occupy like-rank but are not community replies; community replies under official product posts are usage-limit asks.
Cross-thread repeat repliers cluster on Tibo, not Elon/Carmack/simonw: a small meme-reply guild farms the OpenAI community manager.
Length: top-liked replies are almost all under 280 chars except OpenAIDevs skill-rewrite rants and one Carmack-thread technical comment.
No original posts from sama, karpathy, swyx, openai, anthropic, or openaidocs in the 24h window; Tibo (OpenAI) and Elon absorbed the AI-community volume.
